active: Building's coming down on schedule. Be out before it does.
Hard hats on. Fly fast, fly smart.
I call the collapse. You listen.
injured: Still the foreman. Still calling it. Move.
Leg's busted. Building doesn't care. Go.

active: Good money, short schedule. My kind of job.
Sign on. I need a pilot who listens.
Fly it right and nobody gets hurt. Take it.
injured: Running the crew from a cast. I want you on this.
Leg's busted. I still need a pilot. You.
I'll be on site. Slower. Fly it clean.
Good gap. Keep it that tight.
Through. Don't get clever.

active: Watch the cornice! I'm under it!
Back up, I'm right below you!
injured: Not again. Not on me again!
I can't run on this leg. Back off!

active: Ugh! Block came down on me!
I'm hit. Keep the job moving.
Somebody get this off my leg.
injured: That's twice. That's... twice.
I can't get up. I can't get up.

active: Out before the roof. That's the job.
injured: Done. I'll sign it from the stretcher.
Clean work. Wish I'd been upright for it.

active: Too slow. The roof doesn't wait.
Walk it back. Think about the line.
injured: Not like this. Not with me hurt.
Pack it up. We try again slower.

active: Safety's the first grade. The rest is pay.
injured: Grade's fine. Site safety, not so much.
Paperwork says injured. Paperwork's right.

active: Leg's in a cast. Site runs without me for a bit.
I'll be back on the site. Give me time.

bea.memorial: Bea, demolition foreman. Called the collapse, every time.

active: Quietest demolition I've ever seen. Nothing fell that shouldn't have.
Clean takeoff. Keep it that tidy.
injured: You're up. I'm calling it sitting down.
Airborne. Easy around my crew.

active: That was nearly a hole in my wall.
Close. The building doesn't move for you.
injured: Too close. Way too close.
Keep off the structure. Please.

active: Low over the site. Hard hats down.
Watch the rubble, you're right on it.
injured: Low. Mind the crew below.
Easy, there's people down here.

active: That's fast. Fast doesn't stop quickly.
Flat out near a site? Bold.
injured: Slow it down near my people.
Fast. Too fast for me today.

active: Battery's low. Finish and get clear.
Low charge. Don't die over the rubble.
injured: Low battery. Get it out of here.
Pack's low. Land somewhere safe.

active: That's a hit. Walk it back.
injured: Another impact. Not today.
Ugh. I know how that feels.

active: Reset. Start from a safe line.
Back to the start. Plan it this time.
Fresh run. Same rules: get clear.
injured: Reset. Slow and sure.
Back to the top. Breathe.

active: Weather's moving in. Dust'll get worse.
Wind's changing. Watch the loose sheets.
injured: Weather's turning. Everything aches.
Air's changing. Fly it careful.

active: You're parked in the air. Clock's running.
injured: Steady. I'll take steady.
Holding. Fine. I'm not going anywhere.

active: Bea here. No demolition today. Enjoy the buildings standing.
Site's closed, sky's open. Fly smart.
On the radio. Go learn the city.
injured: Bea, off shift and mending. Fly careful.
Still sore. Still watching. Go.
There. Good, steady.
Made it. Nicely done.

active: Props are balanced. Don't make me redo them.
Battery's fresh. Bring it back that way.
injured: Stitched up and still turning wrenches. Go.
Bring it back in one piece. Unlike me.

active: Pays enough to cover the props you'll break. Probably.
Drone's ready. Don't ask about the van.
Take it. I need parts money.
injured: Take it. I'll fix the drone one-handed.
I'm stitched up and it still pays. Go.
Bring the drone back whole. I can't bend down.
Still running. Good.
Gate. I heard every bearing.

active: Hey! Wrench in hand, back off!
injured: Don't you dare. I'm still healing!
I can't move fast. Away!

active: Ow! Okay. Okay. Get a kit.
injured: Twice. You got me twice.
I can't... I can't feel my fingers.

active: Not a scratch. I'm almost proud.
Good. I can go to lunch.
injured: Back in one piece. One of us is.
Fine. Good. I'll sit down now.

active: Do you know what parts cost?
injured: Don't make me fix it like this.
Great. More work, fewer hands.

active: Grade's nice. The repair bill is nicer.
injured: Grade's fine. My insurance is not.
Let's count what's broken. Including me.

active: I'll fix the drone. Who fixes me?
Two jobs off. Don't break anything.

dot.memorial: Dot, mechanic. Kept every drone flying, and complained the whole time.

active: She'll get there. Go easy on the battery.
Look at them all coming home. I'm going to be up all night fixing them.
Props are spinning. Nothing rattled. Good.
Up it goes. Treat it nice.
Liftoff. I can hear every bearing.
injured: Up you go. I can't climb after it today.
Liftoff. Sounds fine. Keep it fine.

active: That was nearly a repair bill.
Keep a gap. Paint isn't free.
injured: Close! I can't fix much with one hand.
Easy. Don't give me more work.

active: Low enough to pick up grit. Stop it.
I'll be cleaning that filter tonight.
injured: Low. Grit. My poor motors.
Please don't eat the ground.

active: That's all she's got. Don't ask for more.
injured: Flat out. Don't cook the motors.
That's my tune-up. Enjoy it.

active: Low battery. I'm not carrying it home.
You're draining it. Land before it sags.
injured: Low battery. I can't run out for it today.
Quarter left. Come home.

active: That's coming out of your pay.
I heard that from the van.
injured: Great. Now we're both broken.
I felt that in my stitches.

active: Reset. Battery's topped, don't waste it.
Fresh pack in. Try not to bend it.
Back to the start. I checked it over.
injured: Reset. One-handed pack swap. You're welcome.
Fresh battery. Be nice to it.

active: Weather's turning. Wet motors, here we go.
injured: Weather's changing. My stitches itch.
Air's turning. Mind the pack.

active: Hovering burns battery too, you know.
injured: Nice and steady. I like steady.
Just hovering. Fine by me.

active: Dot on the radio. Don't break anything on your day off.
Fresh pack, free sky. Bring it back in one piece.
I'm listening to the motors. Go have fun.
injured: Dot here. One hand on the wrench, one on the radio.
Fly gentle. I can't fix much right now.

active: Good. That's a landing I like.
injured: Made it. Good, less work for me.
There. Nice and gentle.

active: Hands on the sticks. Go time.
No. I was going way too fast.
That's my fault. All of it.
Is everyone okay? Talk to me.
I can shave more off that.
I'm on the line. Eyes up, call it as I see it.
Course is clean. Mostly. Listen for me.
You fly, I talk. That's the deal.
injured: Arm's in a sling, but my mouth works fine.
I'll call it from the chair today. Fly kind.

active: I'll be on the line the whole way. Take it.
Nice one. I can see the whole course from my spot.
Fly this and I'll talk you through every turn.
injured: Arm's in a sling, but I can still call it. Take it.
I'll spot from the chair. Just say yes.
Ribs hurt. Eyes work. Let's go.
Gate. Ow. Good line.
Through. I felt that one in my ribs.
Clean. Keep it clean.

active: Watch it, I'm standing in that!
injured: Not again, please, not again!
I can't dodge with this leg. Back off!
I told you. I told you.
That's... not good. That's not good.

active: I barely had to talk. Good.
injured: Done. My ribs thank you.
Finished. Quietly. Nicely done.

active: Shake it off. We go again.
Listen to me next time, yeah?
injured: We'll get it. Slower, maybe.
Not today. I'm too sore to be mad.

active: Fair grade. I'd argue the timing.
injured: Grade's fine. My arm is not.
We'll do better when I can stand.

active: Couple of weeks in a sling. I'll still talk your ear off.
Benched. Somebody else can stand by the gate for a while.
I'll live. Fly kinder next time.

marlo.memorial: Marlo, spotter. Called every gate, even the last one.

active: Down the shaft. Slow. Slower than that.
Floor's under you. Turn left and follow it round.
Long left curve. Keep off the top, it's low.
Still curving left. Don't chase it, let it come.
Walls are close here. Small corrections.
Nearly there. Easy on the speed.
Shutter's ahead, on the floor. Ease off.
There. Drop through the shutter. Gently.
Good flying. I mean it. Every call, you took it clean.
You're up. I've got eyes on you.
Liftoff. Talk to me if it feels wrong.
Up and clean. Now keep it that way.
injured: You're up. I'm watching from the chair.
Liftoff. Easy on my nerves today.

active: That was a hand's width. Breathe.
You shaved paint off that one.
injured: Don't do that to me. Not today.
Close! My ribs just flinched.

active: Low pass, nice. Watch the lip.
You're kissing the ground. Pull a hair.
injured: Low and quick. I'd cheer if it didn't hurt.
That's low. Careful with it.

active: You're flat out. Eyes way ahead.
That's top end. Pick your exit now.
injured: Fast. Too fast for my heart today.
Top end. Pick your exit early.

active: You're on reserve. Land it soon.
injured: Battery's low. Bring it home gentle.
Reserve. Don't make me watch a dead stick.

active: Ooh. That one hurt to watch.
And that's a wall. Shake it off.
injured: That sound. I know that sound.
Contact. Join the club.

active: Back on the pad. Go again.
Fresh air under you. Try it slower.
injured: Reset. Take a breath. I am.
Back to the start. Steady.

active: Weather's moving. Feel the air change.
New weather. Everything's a bit harder now.
injured: Weather's turning. My knee called it.
Sky's changing. Fly it careful.

active: You going to fly, or admire the view?
Nice hold. Now do something with it.
injured: Taking a breather? Fair. Me too.
Nice hold. I'm in no hurry today.

active: Marlo here. No course today, just sky. Go play.
I'm on the radio. Fly anywhere, I'll keep you company.
Free flight, huh? I'll spot for fun.
injured: Marlo, from the couch. Fly something pretty for me.
Still on the mend. I can still talk, though. Go.
Made it. Nice and easy.
There. Good flying.

active: Let the air do the work.
Find the line, keep the line.
I should have seen it. I'm sorry.
Fought the air and the air won.
Follow the beacon. I'll keep the flare lit.
I've got supplies. You've got the drone. Find me.
Weather's bad. Stay calm, so will I.
injured: Bandaged up and still out here. Find me fast.
I'm patched. Not fixed. Hurry.

active: Somebody's waiting on this one. Let's go.
I'll be out there. You'll find me.
Easy pace, clear head. You can do this one.
injured: I'm patched up enough. Take the job.
Sore but steady. Come get me.
I'll keep the flare lit. You keep calm.
Steady. Good.
Keep going. I'm fine. Mostly.

active: Careful, I can hear you coming in hot!
injured: Please. Slowly. I can't take another.
Gently! I'm already hurt!

active: Ow. Okay. I can treat that.
injured: I can't treat this one myself.
Second hit. That's... that's bad.

active: Found me. I knew you would.
injured: Found me. Just in time.
Thank you. I'll rest now.

active: Too late. It's okay. It's okay.
Cold out here. Come back for me.
injured: It's getting dark. Try again.
I'll hold on. Somehow.

active: Let me check you over too.
injured: I'll be off my feet a while.
Grade's fine. I'm not, quite.

active: I set my own splint. Not my best work.
I'll be off the rescue rota a while.
Patched up. Try not to need me.

ozzie.memorial: Ozzie, medic. Waited in the cold for someone to come.

active: On my way. Keep it calm.

injured: You're up. I'm not going anywhere.
Liftoff. Gentle, please.

active: That was close. Heart rate down.
injured: Close. Please be careful.
Easy. I can't patch a drone.

active: Close to the ground. Stay loose.
injured: Low. Careful now.
Easy down there.

active: That's quick. Stay calm with it.
injured: Fast. Too fast for my nerves.
Easy on the throttle.
Low battery. Come back safe.
Running low. Gently home.

active: Hit. It's fine. Reset and breathe.
injured: Ouch. I felt that.
Hit. Okay. We're okay.

active: Fresh start. In for four, out for four.
Back at the start. You're fine.
injured: Reset. Take a moment.
Start again. Slowly.

active: Feel the cold coming in? I do.
New weather. Fly a little softer.
injured: Weather's turning. That's not good for me.
It's changing out here. Hurry, gently.
Still. Good. Rest a second.
Holding. I'll wait.

active: Ozzie here. Warm and dry for once. Go fly.
No one to find today. Just enjoy it.
I'm on the radio. Breathe, then fly.
injured: Ozzie, resting up. Fly something calm.
Still bandaged. Still here. Go on.
Found it. Good.
There. Nicely done.

active: Okay. Okay. Same as the sim, right?
I've flown worse. In a game, but still.
Ooh, this one looks fun. Right? Fun?
I'd fly it. I mean, you'd fly it. Same thing.
Let's do this one. I've got a good feeling.
That was me. That was my fault.
Are they okay? Somebody say something.
I had it. I had it until I didn't.
On it! I think. Yes. On it.
We did it. I'm going to need to sit down for a week.
Off the ground. Same as the sim.
I did not mean to do that.
Ha! Missed it. On purpose. Sort of.
Low and fast, low and fast.
I can see every pebble down there.
Battery's getting low. Wrap it up?
That was a wall. Walls are real.
Back to the pad. Try again.
Read the brief. Then read it again.
Clean, safe, fast. In that order.
Show me why I scouted you.
This one's worth your time. Prove it.
Clean, safe, fast. Here's your chance.
I'd put you on this. Don't make me regret it.
Crew in the zone. Ease off.
You see them? Then fly like it.
That one's on you. Own it.
Stop. Breathe. Your crew needs you careful.
Reset. We learn and go again.
Look at the grade, then look at why.
I knew it the first time I watched you fly. I just didn't know it'd be this.
Clean takeoff. That's the easy part.
Low is fine if you meant it.
Nice. Now do it again on purpose.
Top speed. Now prove you can stop.
Fast is easy. Fast and clean is the job.
That's the ceiling. Fly under it.
Low pack. Bring it in clean.
Back to the start. Slower this time.
Weather changed. So does your plan.
Read the sky before it reads you.
Thinking is good. Too much thinking isn't.
Hovering's a skill. So is moving.
Rin here. No grades today. Fly to learn.
Free flight. Use it. Practice what scares you.
There. Now find a better line back.
Plenty in the tank. Let's not waste it.
Smooth is fast. Smooth is also long.
One down, lots of charge left.
Oh no. I wasn't gentle enough.
That's how you go the distance.
I rushed it. I never rush it.
How long did I stay up?
